text:
samir: Heads up — main CI turned red after merging PR #4782 (sha: c3f9a4b). Smoke-gpu job failing on `smoke/e2e-gpu` step. Can someone take a quick look? cc @devon @nora :eyes:
ci-bot: CI: build 2189123456 on main — FAILED
Failed job: smoke/e2e-gpu
Logs: https://ci.internal/builds/2189123456
Triggered by merge commit c3f9a4b
nora: on it, grabbing logs
devon: I'll try a rerun first. If it's flaky we can bisect.
jen: Which test failing?
nora: Top error: `AssertionError: KVCache mismatch at step 12`
Snippet: ```AssertionError: expected shape (1,512) got (1,256)
 at tests/smoke/test_kv_integration.py:34```
devon: That smells like a tokenization/serialization change. Did the merge touch kvcache or tokenizer util?
samir: PR that merged was https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4782 — small change in `serve/runtime/kv_cache.py` and a perf tweak in tokenization. Author @michael.
ops-oncall: @samir do we need to block? What's the risk? SLA?
samir: Risk: smoke failing for main could affect canary deploys. We have a 15-min mitigation window; prefer rerun + quick bisect. Not yet rolling back.
devon: Rerun kicked: `./ci rerun 2189123456 --job smoke/e2e-gpu`
ci-bot: Rerun started (build 2189123457).
nora: Rerun still failing with same assertion, grabbing full trace.
devon: Ok starting git-bisect locally across last 5 merges. Will report.
michael: I can jump on this — my change touched kv_cache serialization, pushing a patch now to add a defensive check. Will open PR and smoke-run.
jen: If it's a real regression we should revert the merge until we have a patch. Revert window?
samir: Agree. If bisect pins it to PR #4782 we will revert. @ops-oncall prepare revert steps.
ops-oncall: Standby — I have the revert script ready: `git revert -m 1 <merge-commit>` and deploy bypass to avoid canary. Ping me when ready.
devon: Bisect update: bad at c3f9a4b, good at b2a1e4f (previous commit). So PR #4782 is likely culprit.
michael: Confirming locally repro. I'll post patch to fix shapes and add unit test.
nora: Quick mitigation: add a compatibility shim in kv_cache.deserialize that falls back on older shape. I'll open hotfix PR if michael doesn't.
samir: Thanks all. If hotfix lands + CI green we can skip revert. Keep updates here.
ci-bot: Hotfix PR 4785 by nora created, CI pending.
devon: If still red after hotfix, revert will be next. Marking owner: @michael, backup: @nora.
nora: :thumbsup: I'll monitor the runs.
